an7.55:1.1: Satta bhikkhave purisagatiyo desissāmi anupādā ca parinibbānaṃ,
an7.55:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an7.55:1.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.55:2.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti
an7.55:2.2: ‘no c' assa, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissati, yad atthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ pajahāmī' ti; upekhaṃ paṭilabhati.
an7.55:2.3: So bhave na rajjati, sambhave na rajjati, atthuttariṃ padaṃ santaṃ sammappaññāya passati;
an7.55:2.4: tañ ca khvassa padaṃ na sabbena sabbaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti, tassa na sabbena sabbaṃ mānānusayo pahīno hoti, na sabbena sabbaṃ bhavarāgānusayo pahīno hoti, na sabbena sabbaṃ avijjānusayo pahīno hoti.
an7.55:2.5: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.
an7.55:2.6: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave divasasantatte ayokapāle haññamāne papaṭikā nibbattitvā nibbāyeyya,
an7.55:2.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti
an7.55:2.8: ‘no c' assa, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissati, yad atthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ pajahāmī' ti; upekhaṃ paṭilabhati.
an7.55:2.9: So bhave na rajjati, sambhave na rajjati, atthuttariṃ padaṃ santaṃ sammappaññāya passati;
an7.55:2.10: tañ ca khvassa padaṃ na sabbena sabbaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti, tassa na sabbena sabbaṃ mānānusayo pahīno hoti, na sabbena sabbaṃ bhavarāgānusayo pahīno hoti, na sabbena sabbaṃ avijjānusayo pahīno hoti.
an7.55:2.11: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti. 3.
